topic.title: The $10 gym that's paid for by the people who never show up

title: The $10 gym that wants you to stay home 🏋️
description:
Six thousand members pay ten dollars a month. Only three hundred come in. So who pays for the machines?
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
cta: Paying for a gym you skip? Comment

lines.text: You think your gym wants you there? It doesn't. Here's why.
Rohan pays $10 a month, like 6,000 gym members.
That adds up every month, whether anyone trains or not.
Rohan quit in January, but he still pays. Does the gym mind?
Say only 300 members ever walk through the door.
So who pays for all their machines? Rohan does.
Each regular trains on $200 a month, paid by people at home.
